title: Electrochemical insights into manganese–cobalt doped α-Fe2O3 nanomaterial for cholesterol detection: a comparative approach
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,34176-34190
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04373E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Sushmitha S, Subhasmita Ray, Lavanya Rao, Mahesha P. Nayak, Karel Carva, Badekai Ramachandra Bhat
Cobalt-doped α-Fe2O3 nanostructures show enhanced sensitivity of 1364.2 μA mM−1 cm−2 (±0.03, n = 3), selectivity, and stability for nonenzymatic cholesterol detection, with strong clinical potential supported by DFT analysis and human serum sample.
